optical_profile.method: six-parameter optical pose fit to video floor/mat landmarks; lens held fixed
uncertainties: Hand-located corners, approximately 2 px; partly occluded front corner downweighted
Interior and mat dimensions retained; optical intrinsics held fixed to avoid single-plane overfitting
Pixel alignment estimate, not a measured metric camera calibration

joint_map.method: multi-pose wrist mat-corner alignment; approximate visual motor map
joint_map.units: recorded normalized motor coordinates to degrees offset from CAD assembly
assumptions: Mat corners hand-located and some partly occluded; wrist extrinsic estimate retained
Gripper scale/offset estimated from visible jaw opening; no measured servo calibration
Visual replay only; does not establish contact/dynamic or hardware control accuracy

backing_fit.method: bounded capsule/backing silhouette fit to fixed-camera image
assumptions: Circular section and rounded capsule ends
Backing segmentation from upper-right image region

projection.calibration_kind: six-parameter optical pose fit to video floor/mat landmarks; lens held fixed

fixed_response.source: green_cube_red_plate_1 episode 0, raw Chrono replay samples at 3 s intervals
fixed_response.method: one fixed monotonic response per camera, fitted jointly across multiple wrist poses
assumptions: No per-frame color fitting or exposure changes; same filter used in live views and datasets
Fit pixels reject edges and mismatched materials; reported RGB MAE includes the complete frame
Photographic response estimate; not measured shutter, ISO or spectral sensitivity

wrist_optical_fit.method: fixed jaw CAD screw centers and tip alignment; bounded optical correction
assumptions: Small optical alignment correction; mechanical mount mesh remains the supplied STL
Three hand-located features; estimate is not a measured lens calibration

indirect_light.model: deterministic floor/ceiling diffuse return; finite-cell near-field approximation

adapter_screw_heads.shape: domed cap with curved bevel and recessed Phillips opening

materials.mat_collision: flat 1 mm sheet; submillimeter visual creases only

metric: complete-frame RGB8 MAE; no image registration, crop or color matching
limitations: Motor mapping and wrist optical pose are visually estimated
Cube trajectory uses color-centroid triangulation with floor/hold fallbacks; orientation is not tracked
Tray center is visually estimated; tray orientation is not tracked
Kinematic replay does not test physical grasps or calibrated arm dynamics
